small_guidance: Swap the loop order so IC is the outer/static loop and load weight tiles [BLOCK_OC] once per (kd,kh,kw,ic); reduce register pressure (currently 249 regs/thread, occupancy 16%) by using smaller BLOCK_SP=32, BLOCK_OC=32, num_warps=4 and avoid accumulating in a (BLOCK_SP,BLOCK_OC) tile — instead use BLOCK_OC=64 with BLOCK_SP=16 to shrink live state. Also fuse the BN affine + spatial-mean-subtract epilogue directly into the conv kernel's store path to remove the separate BN and bn_meansub passes (which together are ~14% of runtime).
large_guidance: Restructure as an im2col-style gather GEMM where the K-dimension is IC*KD*KH*KW and one program computes a (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SP) output tile via tl.dot, using channels_last (NDHWC) layout so IC loads coalesce. Iterate over k-tiles loading W[k_tile, oc_tile] and gathered X[sp_tile, k_tile] (masking invalid stride positions), accumulate with tl.dot, then in the epilogue apply folded BN scale/shift and subtract the per-(N,C) spatial mean — computing that mean by a second pass or by a separate small reduction kernel fused with the store. This converts the current scalar FMA loop (compute-bound at 67% with 249 regs) into tensor-core/dot-friendly tiles with far lower register pressure and higher occupancy.
